`final class GlBorrowedTextureBackend`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IBorrowedTextureBackend`](/reference/testing/iborrowedtexturebackend/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.snapshot` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlBorrowedTextureBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/snapshot/GlBorrowedTextureBackend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The borrowed texture backend of any OpenGL context, over a snapshot backend and a binding.

## Description

It ships in the `snapshot` jar of base-opengl and in the dev and demo jars of the backends; the published `joid-base-opengl` jar does not hold it.

## Learn more

- [Tools for hosts and tests](/build/base-modules/opengl/#tools-for-hosts-and-tests)
- [Testing a backend](/build/testing-a-backend/)

### borrow

<a id="GlBorrowedTextureBackend-method-isBorrowableTexture"></a>

### isBorrowableTexture

`boolean isBorrowableTexture(Object texture)` 

If `true`, the object is an `Integer` that names a texture of the context.

<a id="GlBorrowedTextureBackend-method-createBorrowableTexture"></a>

### createBorrowableTexture

`Object createBorrowableTexture(int width, int height, int color, boolean mipmapped)` 

Creates an RGBA8 texture of that size in that color, with nearest filtering and repeat wrapping, and every mip level when the boolean is `true`; the texture bound before stays bound.

<a id="GlBorrowedTextureBackend-method-readBorrowableParameters"></a>

### readBorrowableParameters

`Map<String,String> readBorrowableParameters(Object texture)` 

Returns the filters and the wraps of the texture as `MIN_FILTER`, `MAG_FILTER`, `WRAP_S` and `WRAP_T`; the texture bound before stays bound.
